brand.name: Sampéa
brand.description: Sampéa is a perfume oil house for Canada and the US. Every bottle holds 30 ml, every scent is 40% perfume oil, and one bottle serves the whole house.
brand.voice: Quiet and exact, with few words. Talks like a host letting one guest in: calm, plain, never pushing. States the two numbers and lets them stand.

design.thesis: Cream walls at dusk and one bottle catching gold light: the house says very little and lets the glass, the wordmark and two numbers do the talking.

sections.headline: The gold wordmark and the lotus
paragraphs: Every Sampéa bottle carries the gold SAMPÉA wordmark and the lotus on its face. A gold cap closes it, and it stands on a heavy glass base.
The bottle is the same for every scent in the house. You choose a scent by its name.

pages.label: Privacy
pages.title: Privacy Policy
pages.description: How Sampéa handles the personal information you share on this site, when you order, join a list or write to contact@houseofsampea.com.
pages.heading: Privacy policy

sections.intro: This policy explains what personal information Sampéa collects through this website and how it's used. Questions go to contact@houseofsampea.com.

blocks.heading: What we collect
paragraphs: We collect the information you choose to give us: your email address when you join a scent's list or write to us, and the name, shipping address and contact details needed to complete an order.
Payment details are processed at checkout to complete your order. The site may use essential cookies, for example to keep items in your cart.

blocks.heading: How we use it
paragraphs: We use your information only for the reason you gave it to us:
bullets: To tell you about a scent whose list you joined
To process and deliver your orders
To keep the site working and secure

blocks.heading: Sharing
paragraphs: We don't sell your personal information. We share it only with the services that run this website, take payment and deliver orders, and only as much as they need.

blocks.heading: Your choices
paragraphs: You can ask to see, correct or delete the personal information we hold about you, or leave any list, by writing to contact@houseofsampea.com.

blocks.heading: Changes
paragraphs: If this policy changes, the updated version will be posted on this page.

pages.label: Terms
pages.title: Terms of Use
pages.description: The terms that apply when you use the Sampéa website or place an order with Sampéa, the perfume oil house serving Canada and the US.
pages.heading: Terms of use

sections.intro: These terms apply to your use of the Sampéa website and to orders placed through it. By using the site, you agree to them.

blocks.heading: The website
paragraphs: The content on this site, including the SAMPÉA wordmark, the lotus, the text and the photographs, belongs to Sampéa. Please don't copy or reuse it without written permission.

blocks.heading: Products and orders
paragraphs: Product details, availability and prices are shown on each product page and at checkout. An order is accepted when we confirm it. If we can't fulfil an order, we'll tell you and refund any payment taken.
Sampéa sells to customers in Canada and the US.

blocks.heading: Questions about an order
paragraphs: For anything about an order, including returns, write to contact@houseofsampea.com.

blocks.heading: Liability
paragraphs: The site is provided as it is. To the extent the law allows, Sampéa isn't liable for indirect losses arising from your use of the site.

blocks.heading: Changes
paragraphs: We may update these terms. The version on this page is the one that applies.
